title: The Worst Swordsman In His Clan Died . . . Then Woke Up As A Baby
caption:
They called him the worst swordsman in the history of his clan... so he died, and came back as a baby 🗡️👶 Swordmaster's Youngest Son, chapters 1-5. Follow for part 2!

#swordmastersyoungestson #manhwarecap #manhwa #webtoon #regression #comicrecap #recap #fyp
credit: Swordmaster's Youngest Son (Hwangze Penguin / Mr. Big / AZI)
comment: Would you forgive the brothers who tormented you, or make them pay? 👀 Comment below 👇

segments.say: A boy who should be *dead* just woke up as a one-year-old baby.
And this time, he knows exactly which sword to *grab*.
This world is ruled by one family of swordmasters. The *Runcandel* clan.
Their creed is simple. Survival of the *fittest*.
Jin Runcandel is the youngest son. As a baby, he grabbed the patriarch's sword at the Rite of *Choice*.
Everyone thought he would lead the clan one day. They were *wrong*.
He grew up with zero talent. They called him the worst swordsman in the history of the *Runcandels*.
His brothers laughed at his wooden sword. Why even *bother*?
They kicked him down, stomped on him, and snapped his sword in *half*.
Then they ripped up the notes he studied every night, right in front of his *face*.
My siblings tormented me, Jin said. And then the clan threw him *out*.
Outside the clan, a red-haired teacher showed him something the Runcandels *forbid*. Magic.
Years later, deep in the dark, a voice spoke. The god of *shadows*.
I offer you a contract. You will wield *shadow force*, and no curse will ever touch you.
Then the god saw something. Someone had cursed Jin when he was just a *kid*.
A curse called Blade's Delusion. It had been *crushing* his talent his whole life.
The chains on his heart *shattered*. Now, you shall become a spellsword with no *equal*.
Jin grabbed a sword. For the first time in his life, it felt like *nothing*.
Every swing went higher. The worst swordsman in the clan was finally *good*.
And that same night, armored knights found him in the *woods*.
They cut him down. His blood soaked the stones, and everything went *black*.
Then he felt grass under his hands. Huh? I'm supposed to be *dead*.
His nanny Gilly was smiling at him. You can do it, young master *Jin*.
He was one year old again, at the Rite of Choice, with the patriarch's sword *Balisada* in front of him.
Last time, he grabbed it by *chance*. This time, he reached for it on *purpose*.
The elders froze. Jin has chosen *Balisada*.
Six years later, Jin was locked in Storm Castle until he turned *ten*.
One morning, Gilly *screamed*. A dead bird had been left in his room.
It was the twins. Heitona and Deitona, nine years old, and *proud* of it.
In his past life, they tormented him for years. Not *anymore*.
Shadow force burst out of his hands, and he knocked both of them *flat*.
Then he dragged them out into the storm, and left them in the rain to *learn*.
But a guardian knight named Kahn saw *everything*. That power was not aura.
He thought Jin used forbidden *magic*, so he rode off to report it.
Jin knew his contract came back with him. And the curse chains could not hold him this *time*.
Far away, the patriarch heard the report. Assemble the *flagbearers*.
His strongest children, and two hundred knights, marched to Storm *Castle*.
Ciaron Runcandel. A demigod. The strongest man alive, and Jin's *father*.
In his past life, this man treated him like he never *existed*.
The twins tried to blame Jin. Bring Jin to *me*.
Alone, his father asked one question. The twins say you used a special *power*.
Jin did not lie. He opened his hand, and shadow force *bloomed*.
His father went pale. That is the power of the first patriarch's god. The god of *shadows*.
And how will you use it? Jin said, for the *clan*.
His father laughed. What an interesting *lie*!
So Jin told the truth. For *himself*. Good, his father said. I like *that*.
Later, his sister Mary brought a gift. A real phoenix *heart*.
Eat it young, and fire can't hurt you. One day, you can even summon *phoenixes*.
The twins begged for some of the soup. Fine, Jin said. But first, you *dig*.
They dug all night. Their prize? One *teaspoon*. I never said anything about the amount.
Because that tunnel led to a place Jin was *never* allowed in his past life.
Behind a sealed door, deep under the castle, something was *sleeping*.
A man, frozen in a glass prison for a thousand *years*.
No way, Jin whispered. It was *Murakhan*. The guardian dragon of the clan.
That night, footsteps in the dark. A stranger stood in his room. Who the hell are *you*?
Guardian? *Guardian*?! Murakhan roared. Darn those Runcandels!
Then he sniffed the air. That scent. Only Solderet's contractor *smells* like that.
Jin opened his hand, and showed him the *shadows*.
Hey, Solderet. This is a *joke*, right? I waited a thousand years for this tiny *kid*?
He fell to his knees. I made a promise to Solderet, he said. A thousand years *ago*.
Then the shadows spread, and the man became a giant *dragon*.
I am Murakhan. And from now on, I serve Solderet's *contractor*.
The worst swordsman of the Runcandel clan now has a god and a dragon on his *side*. And his family has no idea what's *coming*.
